name: ApplyAll
description: "We get people jobs." A done-for-you job-application service for tech / corporate / knowledge workers in the US & Canada: they apply on your behalf; pitch is "Real interviews. Real companies. Or your money back" (company-stated). Pricing: Standard $249 one-time, Premium $299 one-time. Founded Apr 2023, US. ~4,000 estimated users (founder-stated). Stack: Svelte, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, GCP, Stripe.

mentions.evidence: ~$1,745 MRR (−48.8% L30), 3 active subscriptions, ~$40,444 L30 (+9.7%), ~$122,543 last 3 months, ~$377,047 last 12 months, ~$852,115 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 9, 2026 ~07:00 Warsaw (05:00 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Same product for EU job boards (Pracuj.pl, StepStone, LinkedIn Easy Apply) sold as a €199 "we submit 50 applications this week" pack for Polish remote / DE / NL roles. The hard part is ops quality, not the form-filler code.

whyItPrints: Job seekers hate filling ATS forms; they will pay a few hundred dollars once to outsource it. L30 (~$40k) ≫ MRR (~$1.7k) because almost all revenue is one-time packages, not seats — classic boring services-product hybrid. Channels: word of mouth, affiliate, LinkedIn.
